features.name: Fighting Style: Defense
features.text: +1 AC while wearing armour. Applies: you wear armour.

features.name: Second Wind
features.text: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + 1 HP. 2 uses. Spent uses stay spent for the rest of the adventure; a rest between adventures restores them and every hit point.

features.name: Weapon Mastery: Dagger, Mace, Shortsword
features.text: Dagger (Nick): The extra attack with it from holding two light weapons is part of the Attack action, so it doesn't take your bonus action. Mace (Sap): A creature it hits has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn. Shortsword (Vex): When it hits and deals damage, you have advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn. A mastery applies only while you wield that weapon.

fightingStyle.name: Great Weapon Fighting
fightingStyle.note: Applies: the greatsword is held in two hands.

features.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
features.text: Treat 1s and 2s on damage dice as 3s with a two-handed weapon, or a versatile one held in two hands. Applies: the greatsword is held in two hands.

features.text: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + 3 HP. 2 uses. Spent uses stay spent for the rest of the adventure; a rest between adventures restores them and every hit point.

features.name: Action Surge
features.text: Take one additional action on your turn, except Magic. 1 use. Spent uses stay spent for the rest of the adventure; a rest between adventures restores them and every hit point.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.text: When you fail an ability check, spend a use of Second Wind to add 1d10 to it instead of healing; the use is kept if the check still fails.

features.name: Champion: Improved Critical
features.text: Your attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Champion: Remarkable Athlete
features.text: Advantage on initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.

fightingStyle.name: Two-Weapon Fighting

features.name: Fighting Style: Two-Weapon Fighting
